Functional description

The connection D75 receives the direct supply - pin 9 - from the battery via the line of fuse F39 of the unit under the dashboard B2 .

It receives a supply controlled by the ignition (INT) - pin 7 - via the line of fuse F49, of the unit under the dashboard B2 .

Pin 8 receives a supply with the side lights on, coming from the Body Computer M1 , pin 18 of connector C: the telephone, if fitted is lit up like the other controls E2530 .

Pin 10 of connector D75 is earthed, via the radio earth, pin 12 of connector C of P20 .

Pins 4 and 5 supply the signal to the radio P20 - pins 7 and 8 of connector C, which then controls the speakers E3510 .

Pin 1 is also connected to the radio P20 , pin 1 of connector C (MUTE function).
